title_en: The Stations of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and Her Oppression in the Sources of the Ahl al-Sunna (Part 10)
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari further explores the high status and grievances of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) through Sunni textual references.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Messenger
